source_policy: One daytime request; retain source failure or truncated acquisition. No replacement camera. Existing bounded reconnect policy is unchanged.
runtime: Native streaming worker, CPUExecutionProvider, two CPU threads; no VLM during acquisition
concurrent_execution: Fit-only video decoder audit runs concurrently, also with two CPU threads; this is not a resource-isolated latency benchmark or a paired day/night performance comparison.

inference.tracker_scope: Persistent within uninterrupted observation; reset after sampled-frame gaps above one second

clock: Local decoder arrival/elapsed clock, not camera sensor time or verified image freshness
endpoints: Numeric frame/decision clocks and processing summaries
Candidate alerts retained for independent review, not assigned truth
label_policy: UNASSIGNED until complete independent reviewer annotation. No inferred normal exposure, accuracy, recall or false-alarm rate.
media_policy: Keep public-camera footage and native screenshot local. Publish numerical traces and hashes only; reuse rights are not independently established.
